howto.move.title: Roll around
howto.move.touch:
Drag on the left side of the screen to roll.
Press JUMP at the bottom right to hop!
howto.move.pc:
Move with WASD or the Arrow keys.
Space to jump!
howto.gravity.title: Tap to change “down”!
howto.gravity.touch:
Tap any wall or ceiling and it becomes the floor.
Kororin will fall toward it!
howto.gravity.pc:
Click any wall or ceiling and it becomes the floor.
Kororin will fall toward it!
howto.look.title: Look around
howto.look.touch:
Drag on the right side to turn the camera.
Look up to find the ceiling!
howto.look.pc:
Drag with the mouse to turn the camera.
You can also use QE.
howto.goal.title: Collect stars, reach the goal!
howto.goal.text:
Collect star pieces and touch the big star to clear the stage!
Watch out for purple zappy blocks.
